items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: I apprentice with Sam for six years. He was my post-graduate work. ... But I learned so much from Sam anyway. I mean he taught me a lot.

ctx.x: All right. Gary Smulyan, who told me jazz is four things and among the four things he said can you play what you feel. How does that strike you?
Vague. Yeah you play what you feel. You play — Sam Rivers told me, he says, “Sometimes I improvise just using my mind, not what I hear, sometimes I improvise © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
automatically without thinking about it. You know? Sometimes I improvise while thinking about it.”
